source_refs.note: Positive Feedback: a main subheading of 13.1.2 Feedback Mechanisms, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 3-4.

blocks.text: Positive feedback system aisa mechanism hai jis mein output system ke kaam ko aur barha deta hai. Is tarah positive feedback asal stimulus (tabdeeli ya ukasahat) ko aur tez kar deta hai. Homeostasis mein positive feedback negative feedback se kam hota hai. Yeh aksar un amal mein hota hai jin mein tez aur bari tabdeeli chahiye, maslan khoon ka jamna (blood clotting), dard-e-zeh (labour) aur bachche ki paidaish (childbirth).

Maslan bachche ki paidaish ke waqt uterus (bachcha-dani) ke sukarne (contractions) se nerve impulses control centre (hypothalamus ka ek hissa) tak jate hain. Control centre pituitary gland ko oxytocin hormone chhorne ka signal deta hai. Oxytocin uterus ke contractions aur barha deta hai; yeh barhe hue contractions hypothalamus ko aur zyada nerve impulses bhejte hain, aur aur zyada oxytocin nikalta hai. Yeh positive feedback ka chakkar (loop) bachcha paida hone tak chalta rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche flowchart: Stretching in foetus; bachadani (uterus) ka sukarna (contraction) barhta hai; Uterus walls, Receptors; Part of Hypothalamus, Control centre; Pituitary gland, Effector; Releases oxytocin; uterus ke contractions barhte hain. Barhe hue contractions se dashed lakeer 'Positive feedback' (plus nishan) wapas hypothalamus ke hisse tak jati hai: 'More signals to control centre to release more oxytocin'.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 13.3 mein "relase" chhapa hai; sahi lafz release (chhorna) hai, upar ki figure mein sahi likha hai. Caption mein "system to in childbirth" chhapa hai; sahi "Positive feedback system in childbirth" hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono figures ka asal farq dashed lakeer mein hai. Figure 13.2 mein natija (kam darja-e-hararat) wapas ja kar receptor ka signal band karwata hai, is liye nishan minus (-) hai: amal ruk jata hai. Figure 13.3 mein natija (zyada contractions) wapas ja kar control centre ko aur signal deta hai, is liye nishan plus (+) hai: amal barhta jata hai, yahan tak ke bachcha paida ho jaye.

blocks.title: Be-qaboo positive feedback (Unregulated Positive Feedback)
blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi be-qaboo (un-regulated) positive feedback se sehat ke masail paida ho jate hain. Maslan shadeed sozish (inflammation, jism ke kisi hisse ka soojna aur surkh hona) ya infection mein immune cells (jism ke difai cells) cytokines naam ke proteins chhorte hain. Yeh proteins immune response ko aur tez karte hain. Agar yeh positive feedback theek tarah qaboo na ho to had se zyada sozish aur tissues ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Positive feedback loop kabhi kabhi khatarnak kyun hota hai? Kitab ki misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh khud ko barhata rehta hai; jab tak koi cheez na roke, rad-e-amal be-qaboo hota jata hai. Sakht infection mein nikalne wale cytokines immune response ko barhate rehte hain jab tak sozish tissues ko nuqsan na de.

items: Feedback mein system ka output khud system ko qaboo karta hai.
Negative feedback: output kaam kam kar deta hai (darja-e-hararat, glucose, hormones); sab se aam qism.
Positive feedback: output kaam aur barhata hai (khoon jamna, bachche ki paidaish mein oxytocin).
Be-qaboo positive feedback (cytokines) se had se zyada sozish aur tissue ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.
